title: Suspension for Arrears, Reinstatement and Restart of a Lapsed Program — Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs
content:
**Desk rule.** Deliveries and visits under the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs stop once an invoice stays unpaid beyond the tier's suspension period counted from the day the invoice fell due, counting calendar days with the due day excluded and the final day included, and the year's filter credit is held rather than forfeited while the program is suspended. Service restarts when the arrears are settled and the tier's reinstatement fee is charged, and a lapsed program restarts without a fresh filter survey only inside the tier's restart window counted forward in calendar days from the term end date, the end day excluded and the final day included.

## Suspension

The day the invoice fell due is read from the invoice's own entry on the program, as is the amount unpaid; the caller's account of what has been paid does not replace those entries. The suspension period is the tier's number of calendar days counted after the due day: the due day itself is not counted, and the final day of the period is counted. An invoice still unpaid on the final day of the period, or on any later day, has stayed unpaid beyond the period, and deliveries and visits stop. An invoice still unpaid on the day before the final day has not yet stayed unpaid beyond the period.

*Boundary on hypothetical dates.* An invoice fell due on 2026-03-31 at a tier with a 45-day suspension period. The final day of the period is 2026-05-15. Unpaid on 2026-05-14, the invoice has not yet passed the period and deliveries continue; unpaid on 2026-05-15, it has, and deliveries and visits stop.

While the program stands suspended, the filter sets still owed to the site for the year stay in the program's credit; they are not forfeited by the suspension.

## Reinstatement of a suspended program

Deliveries and visits restart when the arrears are settled, and the tier's reinstatement fee is charged on the restart. The program returns to active status on reinstatement.

## Restart of a lapsed program

A program whose term has ended without renewal stands in expired status. It restarts without a fresh filter survey only inside the tier's restart window: the window is the tier's number of calendar days counted forward from the term end date, the term end day itself not counted and the final day of the window counted. A restart on the final day of the window is inside it; a restart on the day after is outside it.

*Boundary on hypothetical dates.* A program's term ended on 2026-06-30 at a tier with a 30-day restart window. The final day of the window is 2026-07-30. A restart on 2026-07-30 is inside the window and needs no fresh survey; a restart on 2026-07-31 is outside it.

| Program status | Restart provision |
|---|---|
| Suspended | Restarts when the arrears are settled; the tier's reinstatement fee is charged |
| Expired, inside the restart window | Restarts without a fresh filter survey; the tier's reinstatement fee is charged |
| Expired, outside the restart window | The restart-without-survey provision does not apply |
